invariants: database mutations verify affected rows before returning success
multi-row business state and outbox writes use an atomic D1 batch
asynchronous actions return success only after durable Queue or Workflow acceptance
queue acceptance failures persist an explicit failed state and return an error
duplicate webhook acceptance reports the authoritative persisted delivery state
password-reset consumption, password update, and session revocation are atomically guarded
provider-disabled and unsupported operations fail explicitly instead of returning synthetic success
